--allow-verification-overlap.help: Allow verification of similar credentials across detectors

--archive-max-depth.help: Maximum depth of archive to scan.

--archive-max-size.help: Maximum size of archive to scan. (Byte units eg. 512B, 2KB, 4MB)

--archive-timeout.help: Maximum time to spend extracting an archive.

--bare.help: Scan bare repository (e.g. useful while using in pre-receive hooks)

--branch.help: Name of the branch to be scanned

--detector-timeout.help: Maximum time to spend scanning chunks per detector (e.g., 30s).

--drop-unverified-jwt-results.help: Drop unverified results without any verification errors from the JWT detector.

--exclude-detectors.help: Comma separated list of detector types to exclude. Protobuf name or IDs may be used, as well as ranges. IDs defined here take precedence over the include list.

--fail.help: Exit with code 183 if results are found.

--fail-on-scan-errors.help: Exit with non-zero error code if an error occurs during the scan.

--filter-entropy.help: Filter unverified results with Shannon entropy. Start with 3.0.

--filter-unverified.help: Only output first unverified result per chunk per detector if there are more than one results.

--include-detectors.help: Comma separated list of detector types to include. Protobuf name or IDs may be used, as well as ranges.

--json-legacy.help: Use the pre-v3.0 JSON format. Only works with git, gitlab, and github sources.

--log-level.help: Logging verbosity on a scale of 0 (info) to 5 (trace). Can be disabled with "-1".

--max-decode-depth.help: Maximum depth of iterative decoding. Each decoder's output is fed back through all decoders, up to this limit. 1 = single pass, 2+ = chained decoding (e.g., base64 inside utf16).

--max_depth.help: The max commit depth to go back when searching for secrets

--no-allow-verification-overlap.help: Allow verification of similar credentials across detectors

--no-drop-unverified-jwt-results.help: Drop unverified results without any verification errors from the JWT detector.

--no-fail.help: Exit with code 183 if results are found.

--no-fail-on-scan-errors.help: Exit with non-zero error code if an error occurs during the scan.

--no-filter-unverified.help: Only output first unverified result per chunk per detector if there are more than one results.

--no-json-legacy.help: Use the pre-v3.0 JSON format. Only works with git, gitlab, and github sources.

--no-print-avg-detector-time.help: Print the average time spent on each detector.

--no-profile.help: Enables profiling and sets a pprof and fgprof server on :18066.

--no-sarif.help: Output in SARIF format for upload to GitHub code scanning (e.g. via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif).

--print-avg-detector-time.help: Print the average time spent on each detector.

--profile.help: Enables profiling and sets a pprof and fgprof server on :18066.

--quiet.help: suppress the summary line when no findings are reported

--results.help: Specifies which type(s) of results to output: verified (confirmed valid by API), unknown (verification failed due to error), unverified (detected but not verified), filtered_unverified (unverified but would have been filtered out). Defaults to verified,unverified,unknown.

--rules.help: Ignore default regexes and source from json list file

--sarif.help: Output in SARIF format for upload to GitHub code scanning (e.g. via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif).

--since_commit.help: Only scan from a given commit hash
